mechanism: Tramadol inhibits reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine while phenelzine is an irreversible MAOI, creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis through additive monoaminergic effects.
action: This combination is contraindicated; avoid concurrent use and allow adequate washout period (at least 14 days after stopping phenelzine before starting tramadol, or 24 hours after stopping tramadol before starting phenelzine).
